question:
What is the value of X?

 X=(7)/(5)+left{(1)/(5)-(1)/(3)right} times (5)/(2)~
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b98049e03feb8065ac70d1d1e534ff56cd12464a4f43944b76f5d91a4dcfaad0.png] 

**Calculation:**

 X=(7)/(5)+left{(1)/(5)-(1)/(3)right} × (5)/(2)~

⇒ 7/5 + {(3 - 5)/15} × 5/2

⇒ 7/5 - 2/15 × 5/2

⇒ 7/5 - 1/3

⇒ (21 - 5)/15

⇒ 16/15

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
